answer: A pearl-sealed commit-reveal bond blocks fakes: each locks 70 credits, posts its work hash. The plan names a wander route. After a glacier-slow window of one epoch, the agent reveals work and nonce; auditors recompute the hash, check the route. Mismatch burns the bond; a copy-reveal ring fails the check. First commit 35, k-th 35+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 35 once, keeps its bond.
